permissionDefault.value: ask: each action goes to the answerer chain, and with no answerer the request resolves unavailable and the caller denies it; policy never rejects everything without asking
permissionDefault.note: Shipped presets: workspace-write with ask, and danger-full-access with never.

sandboxDefault.value: workspace-write in the shipped preset table (paired with ask): writes only under the workspace root; danger-full-access bypasses confinement
sandboxDefault.note: The pages do not name one deployment default mode. Per call, an approved mode beats the session's last sandbox/mode event, which beats the deployment default. Modes govern filesystem effects only, not network.

evidence.locator: In-process backends: permission, depth, and seed

subagents.note: An optional capability whose providers coexist by name: spawn, fork, ACP, Codex, Claude Code, and DSH SDK. Children run one level deeper. Read Only and Workspace Write parents pass their sandbox to children with approval never.

guidance.text: dsh is a developer preview and its maintainers expect compatibility-breaking changes; recheck flags and config after each upgrade.
A model added by hand offers no effort control until its reasoning levels are declared in the profile's cordis.patch.yml.
Behind an OpenAI-compatible gateway, dsh may need compat switches such as supportsDeveloperRole false and maxTokensField max_tokens, or the gateway refuses requests.
Custom-provider models are text-only unless their input list names image; declaring it does not verify the endpoint serves images.
Model discovery calls GET /models and can fail on some gateways; add model ids by hand when it returns nothing.
